prompt: Write a workflow that fetches the most recent user from Asana, append " (synced from OpenFn)" to its name, then creates a matching user in OpenHIM Core.
workflow_yaml:
name: dry-run
jobs:
  fetch:
    name: Fetch record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-asana@latest'
    body: |
      request('GET', '/users', { query: { limit: 1, opt_fields: 'name,email' } });
  post:
    name: Post record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-openhim@latest'
    body: |
      createClient(state => {
        const u = state.data.data[0];
        return { clientID: u.gid, name: `${u.name} (synced from OpenFn)`, roles: ['default'], email: u.email };
      });
triggers:
  webhook:
    type: webhook
edges:
  webhook->fetch:
    source_trigger: webhook
    target_job: fetch
  fetch->post:
    source_job: fetch
    target_job: post
    condition_type: on_job_success
